verdict.rationale: v0 provides a programmatic API/SDK (v0-sdk) allowing chat/code-gen calls to be scripted, and GitHub integration runs CI checks and can auto-fix CI failures, suggesting some automation-friendly hooks; but there's no documented headless CLI mode or explicit CI-runner integration pattern (e.g., GitHub Actions example) for orchestrating v0 itself within a pipeline. missing for 10: a documented CLI/headless mode, an official CI/CD pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions), and independent confirmation of running v0 fully unattended in automation.
